tpButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    else
        textbox.Text = "Invalid number!"
    end
end)

    while true do
        wait(0.5)
        if arEnabled then
            if hrp.Position.Y >= 100000000000 then
                player.Character:BreakJoints()
            end
        end
    end
end)
